capabilities: Move daily notes into date-based folders automatically
Choose between Year, Year/Month, and Year/Month/Week structures
Customize year, month, and week folder name formats with Moment.js patterns
disambiguation: It does not create daily notes itself; it moves and organizes daily notes into date-based folder structures.
extras: Deprecated: the README explains that core Daily Notes format strings like YYYY/MM/DD now cover this functionality and includes a migration guide; the repository remains only for reference.
intentEvidence: Core Integration: Works seamlessly with Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin
problem: Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin puts all daily notes in one folder, so long-running vaults become hard to navigate by date.

relations.evidence: Core Integration: Works seamlessly with Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin

replacedBy: Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin (via date format strings)
summary: Folder organizer that sorts daily notes into Year, Year/Month, or Year/Month/Week folder structures using customizable Moment.js date formats.
